name: sg-guard
description: Snow Gloves guard: keeps the ERP connector read-only and ids-only, redacts personal data from MCP results, and refuses user-installed mods that spawn processes or fetch without a catalog card

erpServerId.title: ERP server id
erpServerId.description: Id of the ERP MCP connector (the part of mcp__<id>__ tool names). Changes if the connector is re-created

redactResults.title: Redact MCP results
redactResults.description: Replace emails, phone numbers, card numbers and secrets in MCP tool results with placeholders

supplyChain.title: Supply-chain check
supplyChain.description: Refuse user-tier mods that spawn processes, or fetch, without an add card. Only effective when this mod is in prependPlugins

platformRoot.title: Platform root
platformRoot.description: Path of the snow-gloves-os checkout. Empty: two folders above this mod
